info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Lookup API enables users to retrieve detailed information about wholesale trading programs based on specified parameters. By utilizing the param1 identifier, developers can efficiently access program data, helping financial institutions and trading professionals to make informed decisions. This API is particularly useful for application integrations in banking environments that require quick access to trading specifications. Typical consumers include financial analysts and trading systems looking to optimize their program trading strategies.
